content.text: Backticks clash; pass the command via params.

arguments.code: async ({ shell: { exec } }, cmd: string) => exec(cmd, { timeoutMs: 280000 })
arguments.params:
sed -i 's/^- Set `context_files: false` to load no files.$/&\n/' docs/security.md
sed -i 's/other than `coding-tools` and `pi-action`\./other than `coding-tools`, `pi-action-context`, and `pi-action`./' docs/extensions.md
sed -i 's/^2\. The sections of the pi-durable extensions, in the order of `extensions`/2. `available_skills`: the [skills](skills.md#the-system-prompt) that pi can use, from the built-in `pi-action` extension. It is not there when no skill is listed.\n3. The sections of the pi-durable extensions, in the order of `extensions`/' docs/prompts.md
sed -i 's/^Without context files and extensions, the system prompt is empty\./Without context files, skills, and extensions, the system prompt is empty./' docs/prompts.md
grep -n 'context_files: false. to load' -A2 docs/security.md; sed -n 15,21p docs/prompts.md; grep -rln '^<<<<<<<\|^>>>>>>>' src docs *.md
git add -A && npm run check 2>&1 | tail -40
